key_insight: Interpreting the evolving kinematics and stress in exponential shear enables one protocol to recover both the steady shear flow curve and the steady planar extensional viscosity curve.
engineering_relevance: This approach could expand complex-fluid characterization using commercial strain-controlled rheometers rather than separate shear and extensional tests.
method: Impose exponential shear and measure time-varying torque and normal force.
Analyze the evolving eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the flow kinematics and sample stress.
Define material functions that map measurements to shear and planar extensional viscosity curves.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports support from nonlinear viscoelastic constitutive-model simulations, asymptotic analysis, and experiments with several polymeric liquids.
watch_item: Implementation requires accurate transient torque and normal-force measurements; applicability beyond the tested polymeric liquids remains to be established.
paper_title: A new approach to measuring both the steady flow curve and the planar extensional viscosity of complex fluids using exponential shear
